module_purpose: Shared styling helpers for ModalScreens (dialogs / popups).
responsibilities: Shared styling helpers for ModalScreens (dialogs / popups).

public_api.name: apply_accent_to
public_api.description:
Paint the accent colour onto a modal's container border and title label.

This is called from ``on_mount`` so the popup matches the user's current
theme immediately (no app restart needed).
